neighbours.label: The interjection token 'Ah' opening a line of dialogue ("Ah, there you are"), not other interjections such as Oh, Well or Hmm
fire: The old man squinted at the letter. "Ah, so it came at last," he murmured.
She opened the door to find her brother. "Ah, you made it after all."
The professor smiled at the question. "Ah, now that is a good one."
He tasted the soup slowly. "Ah, just like my mother used to make."
The guard checked the list twice. "Ah, here is your name, go ahead."
She looked at the photo for a while. "Ah, those were happy days."
The detective picked up the glove. "Ah, this changes everything."
He finally found the keys in his coat. "Ah, there they are."
quiet: The old man squinted at the letter. "Oh, so it came at last," he murmured.
She opened the door to find her brother. "Well, you made it after all."
The professor smiled at the question. "Hmm, now that is a good one."
He tasted the soup slowly. "Yes, just like my mother used to make."
The guard checked the list twice. "Okay, here is your name, go ahead."
She looked at the photo for a while. "Oh, those were happy days."
The detective picked up the glove. "Look, this changes everything."
He finally found the keys in his coat. "Finally, there they are."

predictions: 'Ah' at the start of quoted speech reaches 0.5-0.8. The same lines opening with Oh, Well, Hmm or Yes stay under 0.15.
